title: How Supermarkets Use Statistics to Manipulate You
text:
Supermarkets aren’t arranged randomly…

import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

data = pd.DataFrame({
    "Zone": ["Entry", "Middle", "Checkout"],
    "Impulse Buy Rate (%)": [12, 34, 58]
})

fig = px.bar(data, x="Zone", y="Impulse Buy Rate (%)",
             title="Impulse purchase rate by store zone")
fig.show()
